scope.checkpoint: E2/M1 LangGraph Runnable Backend / UI Local Candidate
behavior_change: Replace the production route's hand-written DurableFakeAgentLoop call with one startup-compiled, eight-node LangGraph workflow.
Use a separate LangGraph SQLite checkpointer as the only production graph-cursor authority while retaining SQLite Asset Repository as canonical product truth.
Persist a minimal typed graph state containing only identity, workflow/topology, cursor, projection and terminal-candidate fields.
Implement allow, policy-deny, model/format failure, stale, missing, corrupt, incompatible, cancellation, tool-exception and repository-exception safe terminal paths.
Prevent model and tool effect replay with run/node/attempt effect keys and make terminal writes idempotent.
Fail closed without replay when a node effect is already STARTED but its completion is unknown.
Bind restart compatibility to workflow, topology, base version, model ID, loopback server, model-config hash and code commit.
Reject direct and indirect imported-instruction attempts without dispatching a tool or changing the canonical asset.
Record sanitized node Trace with checkpoint, selected edge, policy, tool, verification, terminal and finding metadata.
Inject CODE_COMMIT into durable run identity; UNCOMMITTED is explicitly local-development-only.
non_goals: No W7900, ROCm, real Qwen2.5-14B vLLM execution or Serving Reference S1.
No E3 or later milestone behavior.
No checkpoint-2 acceptance, E2 promotion or merge claim.

quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Implements a private local multi-step Agent workflow with durable planning, policy-controlled Tool Calling, current-source grounding, restart recovery, explicit terminal states and sanitized observability.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Provides the local code and reproducible test candidate for E2 checkpoint-2 review. It deliberately excludes the W7900 evidence assigned to kinnyuww.

commands.result: 31/31 public QA tests and the repository contract gate passed.
Checked-in JSON Schema and OpenAPI are current.

commands.cmd: npm run verify:contracts && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
commands.result: 15/15 contract provenance checks, 95/95 Vitest tests, typecheck, ESLint and production build passed.
17/17 Playwright cases passed against the real loopback FastAPI service.
Captured a public asset, state-derived progress, M1 workspace, retrieval Trace, checkpoint-linked node Trace, inspected UI screenshot and SHA-256 manifest.
The E2-scoped public artifact, progress and current-source retrieval Trace passed the fail-closed artifact gate.

retained_failures: The first trace-to-checkpoint binding attempt supplied checkpoint_ns as a graph subgraph selector and raised a Subgraph-not-found error; production configuration now uses thread_id only and all node Trace rows bind checkpoint IDs.

The first denial implementation called ToolExecutor from verify_run_result to manufacture a DENIED record; it was replaced by a policy-suppressed zero-effect audit record and a regression proves zero tool dispatches.

The first public artifact-gate attempt used chair_public_complete and correctly failed because that fixture expects M5 route decisions outside E2; the retained E2 packet now uses chair_incomplete and does not fabricate future route eligibility.
The previous checkpoint-2 packet described the pre-LangGraph implementation and cannot support the corrected architecture.
recovery: All retained defects were corrected before the complete local gate rerun.
Missing, corrupt, incompatible and stale cursors now stop safely without model or tool replay.
Runtime identity drift and indeterminate started effects now stop safely without resuming model or tool execution.
Cancellation, unexpected tool failure and transient repository failure now leave durable explicit terminal states.
unverified: Exact implementation commit binding; the current packet is intentionally dirty-tree and must be regenerated after an authorized commit.
Independent quality-owner acceptance of E2 checkpoint 2.
W7900/ROCm/Qwen2.5-14B real-model execution owned by kinnyuww.
